diagram_previews.alt: Equilateral triangle ABC with centre O and outward squares ABDE, BCFG and CAHI, shaded. A red equilateral triangle has its sides along the lines GD, EH and IF; a blue dashed circle about O touches these three lines, and a blue radius from O through B reaches the line GD.

difficulty_rationale: Needs the convex hull, the distances to its side lines, and the sum-of-distances property of the equilateral triangle to prove the lower bound.
